comparison.objective: Loosen a nut using an adjustable wrench after snugging its movable jaw onto the flats.
comparison.physical_skill: Roll-jaw sizing, wrench alignment, torque application, and avoidance of jaw slip or rounded flats.
comparison.success_condition: Nut loosened with the jaw fitted snugly and without rounding or unsafe slip.
comparison.reason: Although both use bounded torque, this task tests adjustable-wrench fitting and nut loosening. It lacks fine socket insertion, tool withdrawal during setting motion, relocking, and response-based dynamic commissioning.
